links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompt without constraints (less constrained prompts: Zero-Shot, Contextualized, Meta, Persona)
links.outcome: Readability (SMOG index and FKGL) of LLM-generated gastroenterology and hepatology patient explanations
links.effect: More constrained prompts yielded significantly more readable outputs, and less constrained prompts yielded less readable outputs (p < 0.001). No prompt technique or model consistently reached a 6th grade level by SMOG.
links.quote: However, prompts with less constraints yield less readable outputs, while prompts with more constraints yield significantly more readable outputs (p < 0.001).
